0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 2-3 on the road, 2-game losing streak, 8th in the East) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 4-0 at home, 3-game winning streak, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West). The Wizards are without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The Thunder are missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Jaylin Williams is day-to-day with back spasms and is a game-time decision. This season's series has no games yet, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost 0-2, including a 132-111 loss in Washington on March 21, 2026.
